notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Orthion.
description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token, adding {R}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
Optionally, if you have an additional {R}{R} available, you may use Orthion's second ability once you have a large amount of {C} to get infinite {R}, which can then be used to activate Orthion infinitely targeting any other creature(s).
